note: Requirement register: one row per requirement in the brief, with implementation, verification and an official source.

requirements.requirement: Read the Kalshi demo REST Trade API at the documented base URL.
requirements.implementation: collector/kalshi.py uses https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 with fallback to https://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 (both documented).
requirements.verification: Endpoint list read from official docs; live responses captured in data/verify-api.json by tools/probe_api.py.

requirements.requirement: Read the Kalshi demo WebSocket API at the documented URL.
requirements.implementation: collector/kalshi_auth.py builds the documented handshake signature; tools/probe_api.py attempts both demo WS roots unauthenticated and (when secrets exist) authenticated.
requirements.verification: Official docs state WebSocket connections require an authenticated handshake; the probe records the actual outcome rather than assuming it.

requirements.requirement: Track the highest dollar-amount live events.
requirements.implementation: markets are ranked by est_volume_24h_dollars (volume_24h_fp × last price) and displayed in that order on the dashboard and every topic page.
requirements.verification: metric formula and caveat are printed in data/meta.json (volume_metric_note) and on the dashboard footer note.

requirements.requirement: Restrict coverage to gas prices, elections, culture, crypto and golf only.
requirements.implementation: collector/topics.py contains only these five topics; each has an explicit rule over official category/categories/tags fields and an explicit exclusion list.
requirements.verification: Rules are published in data/meta.json; tests/test_pipeline.py asserts an unrelated sport (basketball) is not matched.

requirements.requirement: Alert on contract price swings of at least $0.10 in either direction.
requirements.implementation: collector/alerts.py detect(): |price_now − price_<window>| ≥ 0.10, per market, with a retrace-based re-arm latch.
requirements.verification: tests/test_engine.py tests the exact $0.10 boundary, below-threshold silence, both directions, latch behaviour and re-arm.

requirements.requirement: Present the alerts as a simple real-time scrolling chat.
requirements.implementation: index.html #chatAll — newest first, auto-refresh every 60 s, flash on newly arrived messages, pause button.
requirements.verification: Rendered from data/alerts.json all_feed; every message links to its API source URL.

requirements.requirement: Provide a second filtered chat containing only the events the model scores as high ROI.
requirements.implementation: index.html #chatRoi reads data/alerts.json high_roi_feed; the filter (ROI on risk ≥ 25% and entry in $0.10–$0.90) is stated on the page.
requirements.verification: collector/alerts.py qualifies() implements the filter; the threshold appears in data/alerts.json high_roi_rule.

requirements.requirement: Keep tracking live events until they resolve, and record whether they resolved yes or no.
requirements.implementation: collector/resolutions.py polls every tracked market and copies result / settlement_value_dollars verbatim; resolutions.html lists state and result.
requirements.verification: Only result ∈ {yes,no} sets state=resolved; tools/verify_data.py fails a resolved record without a yes/no result.

requirements.requirement: Automate simulated trades to test different strategies.
requirements.implementation: collector/strategy.py defines five strategies with fixed size and explicit rules; collector/trading.py opens, settles and summarises them each cycle.
requirements.verification: tests/run_fixture_pipeline.py runs the whole engine offline; tests/test_engine.py checks the settlement arithmetic.

requirements.requirement: Track portfolio performance on the Kalshi demo account.
requirements.implementation: collector/trading.py sync_demo_portfolio() reads /portfolio/balance and /portfolio/positions with signed requests when secrets exist; otherwise portfolio.json records that it is unconfigured.
requirements.verification: Requires repository secrets KALSHI_DEMO_API_KEY_ID and KALSHI_DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY, which this session cannot create. Published as a flagged item.

requirements.requirement: Analyse results and categorise trades / build strategies by trade type.
requirements.implementation: data/analytics.json breaks P&L, win rate, invested capital and ROI down by strategy, topic and side; performance.html renders all three tables.
requirements.verification: summarise() computes each figure from settled trades only; verify_data.py requires all five strategy buckets to exist.

requirements.requirement: Execute trades on events and track their performance.
requirements.implementation: tools/execute_demo_order.py places a signed POST /portfolio/events/orders against the demo account when credentials exist; paper trades always run and are performance-tracked.
requirements.verification: Order endpoint and payload shape taken from the official Create Order (V2) reference. Real execution is untested here because no demo credentials exist in this session.

requirements.requirement: Live interactive dashboard with price graphs; x axis time with seconds/minutes/hours ranges, y axis contract price.
requirements.implementation: assets/js/chart.js PriceChart: y fixed $0.00–$1.00, x = UTC time, ranges 1m/5m/30m/1h/6h/24h, bid/ask band and swing dots.
requirements.verification: Range list and y-domain are in the code and mirrored by the on-page caption; data comes from data/history/<ticker>.json.

requirements.requirement: Show current liquidity and how many contracts are available at a given price.
requirements.implementation: collector/collect.py capture_orderbook() stores both book sides as [price, contracts] with totals and notional; tables show 'contracts at best ask' and order-book panels show levels.
requirements.verification: Order book structure per official docs (bids only; YES asks implied as 1 − NO bid).

requirements.requirement: Suggest improvements to make the site more live and interactive.
requirements.implementation: docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md lists 12 concrete suggestions with the constraint that each is either implemented or explicitly deferred with a reason.
requirements.verification: Each suggestion states its current state; nothing is claimed as live unless it is.

requirements.requirement: Simplified graphs and charts, including which events/links may have caused a jump ≥ $0.10.
requirements.implementation: Every alert links to the Kalshi API row and to the topic page; docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md explains the news-attribution limit. No news feed is asserted.
requirements.verification: The project has no verified news-source feed; attributing a jump to a news story would be inference, so the column stays empty and is flagged.

requirements.requirement: Organise and simplify: topics separate, events within a topic grouped together.
requirements.implementation: One page per topic (topics/*.html); dashboard groups tables by topic; events are the grouping key for markets in data/events.json.
requirements.verification: tools/check_site.py asserts every topic page exists and every nav link resolves.

requirements.requirement: No manual input: the pipeline must run itself.
requirements.implementation: .github/workflows/collect.yml runs every 5 minutes, commits refreshed data, and re-runs verification; .github/workflows/probe-api.yml refreshes the API evidence every 6 hours.
requirements.verification: Workflow files are in the repo; run history is visible under the Actions tab.

requirements.requirement: Review the repo line by line and flag irregularities.
requirements.implementation: README.md 'Repo review' section; flagged.html lists every irregularity with a source link.
requirements.verification: Repo consisted of a one-line README at commit 003447e; findings recorded.

requirements.requirement: Publish a GitHub Pages site: clean landing page, subpages by category, tables with sources.
requirements.implementation: Static site at repo root served by Pages; index.html + topics/*.html + performance/resolutions/requirements/sources/flagged.
requirements.verification: tools/check_site.py validates internal links, required pages and required table headers; Pages deploy confirmed after merge.

requirements.requirement: Every table row must carry a source link to an official site; unconfirmable values left blank and flagged.
requirements.implementation: Every market, alert, resolution and trade row renders a source link to its Kalshi API URL; tools/verify_data.py rejects a row without one.
requirements.verification: verify_data.py runs in CI on every push and fails the build on a missing/non-official source.

requirements.requirement: Coordinate with parallel sessions via COORDINATION.md.
requirements.implementation: COORDINATION.md holds the task board, ownership, file scopes, branch policy and the log.
requirements.verification: Board was created before any work began; no other session's claim was present.

requirements.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining important details.
requirements.implementation: docs/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md; linked from the dashboard and sources page.
requirements.verification: Every factual statement in it links to the source it came from.
